decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-21, each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's instruction of that day to go over Adam and Eve in Genesis 1-5 and the verses that refer back to them; no person has reviewed this ruling
policy: Where the narrative of Genesis 2-4 speaks of Adam as הָאָדָם, the man, or as the woman's husband, the word is his, as 'the woman' is Eve's. Where אָדָם is mankind (GEN 1:26-27; 5:1-2, where God called their name Adam, male and female), a man yet to be (GEN 2:5), the man the woman is named from (GEN 2:23) or any man (GEN 2:24), it is nobody's. The woman of 1 Timothy 2:14 is Eve, named in the verse before; the last Adam of 1 Corinthians 15:45 is Christ.
source: Essenthos, Adam, Eve and the last Adam where the verse speaks of them by another word, each word read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's instruction of 2026-10-21

rulings.why: וַיִּיצֶר ... אֶת־הָאָדָם: the LORD God formed the man of the dust of the ground. The man he formed is Adam, whom 1CO 15:45 calls the first man Adam.
וַיְהִי הָאָדָם לְנֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה: the man became a living soul, the words 1CO 15:45 says of the first man Adam.
There he put the man whom he had formed: Adam, the man of 2:7.
The LORD God took the man and put him into the garden of Eden: Adam.
The LORD God commanded the man: Adam, the one man the narrative has.
It is not good that the man should be alone: Adam, before the woman is made.
Brought them unto the man to see what he would call them: Adam.
Whatsoever the man called every living creature, that was the name thereof: Adam.
The man gave names to all cattle: Adam. The second אָדָם of the verse, pointed without the article, is ruled in the owner's reading report.
The LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man: Adam.
The rib, which the LORD God had taken from the man: Adam.
And brought her unto the man: Adam.
And the man said, This is now bone of my bones: Adam. The man of 'taken out of Man' in the same verse is the word the woman is named from, and is not ruled.
They were both naked, the man and his wife: Adam.
She gave also unto her husband with her, and he did eat: her husband is Adam.
The man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God: Adam.
The LORD God called unto the man: Adam.
And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me: Adam.
Said to the woman: thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee. Her husband is Adam.
And the man called his wife's name Eve: Adam.
Behold, the man is become as one of us, and now, lest he put forth his hand: the man who ate of the tree, Adam.
So he drove out the man: Adam, sent forth from the garden in 3:23.
And the man knew Eve his wife: Adam.
